snip.t: Ethambutol (E): Bacteriostatic, inhibits cell wall synthesis — Optic neuritis (red-green colour blindness)
Optic neuritis: Blurred vision, red-green colour blindness.
| Multiple sclerosis | Relapsing‑remitting course, optic neuritis, sensory level, young adult | MRI shows periventricular plaques, oligoclonal bands in CSF |
| Multiple sclerosis | Variable neurological signs, optic neuritis | MRI shows demyelinating lesions; sensory and motor signs often dissociated. |
Fundoscopy: Papilledema, optic disc pallor, retinal hemorrhages — Raised ICP, optic neuritis (HIV), malaria retinopathy
| Fundoscopy (direct) | Papilledema, optic disc changes | Papilledema → raised ICP; disc pallor → optic neuritis |

*Answer*: Baseline and monthly liver function tests (isoniazid, pyrazinamide hepatotoxicity), visual acuity (ethambutol optic neuritis), renal function (pyrazinamide), and adherence counseling; also repeat CD4 count at 2 months to assess immune recovery.
